notes: Initial conservative baselines. Run scripts/update-performance-baseline.sh --confirm after first full CI run to replace with real measurements.

cold_launch_seconds.description: App cold launch time measured by XCTApplicationLaunchMetric (no prior process)

warm_launch_seconds.description: App warm launch time measured by XCTApplicationLaunchMetric (process already in memory)

session_scroll_cpu_pct.description: CPU usage percentage during session list scroll measured by XCTCPUMetric

session_scroll_hitch_ms_per_s.description: Scroll hitch time ratio during session list scroll (lower is better, Apple recommends <5ms/s)

chat_scroll_cpu_pct.description: CPU usage percentage during chat message list scroll measured by XCTCPUMetric

chat_initial_render_cpu_pct.description: CPU usage percentage during initial chat view render measured by XCTCPUMetric

search_query_cpu_pct.description: CPU usage percentage during search query execution measured by XCTCPUMetric

search_query_clock_s.description: Wall-clock time for a search query response measured by XCTClockMetric

incremental_search_cpu_pct.description: CPU usage percentage during incremental/typeahead search measured by XCTCPUMetric

memory_session_browse_mb.description: Memory footprint during session list browsing and scrolling measured by XCTMemoryMetric

memory_session_leak_mb.description: Memory growth across repeated session browsing cycles (detect retain cycles) measured by XCTMemoryMetric

memory_chat_navigation_leak_mb.description: Memory growth across repeated chat navigation cycles (detect retain cycles) measured by XCTMemoryMetric

large_list_100_cpu_pct.description: CPU usage percentage scrolling a list of 100 session items (PERF_ITEM_COUNT=100)

large_list_100_hitch_ms_per_s.description: Hitch time ratio scrolling a list of 100 session items (PERF_ITEM_COUNT=100)

large_list_1k_cpu_pct.description: CPU usage percentage scrolling a list of 1000 session items (PERF_ITEM_COUNT=1000)

large_list_10k_cpu_pct.description: CPU usage percentage scrolling a list of 10000 session items (PERF_ITEM_COUNT=10000)

memory_session_idle_mb.description: Peak memory during session list idle state — hard limit enforced by XCTAssert in MemoryThresholdTests (limit: 50 MB)

memory_chat_active_mb.description: Peak memory during active chat session — hard limit enforced by XCTAssert in MemoryThresholdTests (limit: 75 MB)

idle_cpu_pct.description: CPU usage percentage while app is idle on session list (no user interaction) measured by XCTCPUMetric

background_cpu_pct.description: CPU usage percentage while app is backgrounded (background task execution) measured by XCTCPUMetric

chat_streaming_cpu_pct.description: CPU usage percentage during active chat streaming response measured by XCTCPUMetric

crash_free_sessions_pct.description: Percentage of sessions that complete without a crash (100 = no crashes observed)
